hooks.name: Cite AWS claims
hooks.description: After the agent edits a docs page, remind it to ground AWS claims in the source lock or AWS docs.

action.prompt: You just edited a docs page. Check it against .kiro/steering/aws-source-lock.md: every ACM / Private CA / pricing / renewal behavioural claim must appear in the verified-facts list or be backed by a docs.aws.amazon.com or aws.amazon.com pricing link. Mark unverified lab evidence explicitly. If a claim cannot be sourced, use the aws-docs MCP or remove it. Keep tone direct — no hedging lectures.
